summary: structure OK; tool state 50 ok / 0 fail / 0 skip; connection report valid; tests file schema-valid and label cross-check clean; lint best-practice warnings only

diagnostics.message: Workflow does not specify a creator.
Steps without annotation (fastqc, multiqc, unzip_filtered, dada2_learn_errors_*, dada2_dada_*, dada2_merge_pairs, dada2_make_sequence_table, fastq_to_fasta, ...).

Connection checker resolves __MERGE_COLLECTION__ outputs (merge_otu_tables, merge_lca_tables, merge_blast_sets, merge_fasta_sets) to collection_type null, so downstream nbc, lca, lca_dedup, phyloseq, flag_length and proportional_filter report map_over None; the intended 4-element list map-over is not statically verified.
diagnostics.routes_to: run-workflow-test (runtime proof); gxwf connection inference upstream

residual_runtime_risks.risk: Four-set map-over after __MERGE_COLLECTION__ (identifiers asv, zotu, asv_lulucurated, zotu_lulucurated) and identifier-matched multi-input mapping in lca/phyloseq/proportional_filter.

residual_runtime_risks.risk: User-defined tools rely on $(inputs.x.element_identifier) on mapped-over data inputs (relabel_reads, lulu, phyloseq, flag_length, proportional_filter) and on \$ / \${ escaping inside configfiles.
residual_runtime_risks.proof: job command lines and stderr of those steps; requires a Galaxy that supports GalaxyUserTool run: embedding (test.galaxyproject.org is 27.0.dev0)

residual_runtime_risks.risk: Container pulls for custom images (adbennett/ocom_nbc:v1.4 1.8 GB, phyloseq images ~0.7 GB, mahsamousavi/lulu:2019) and the runner allowing arbitrary docker.io images for user tools.
residual_runtime_risks.proof: job states / runner logs for nbc, phyloseq, lulu
